female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

loan-history-interaction.title: Mentioning a history of successful loan repayments has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
loan-history-interaction.body: While referencing successful previous loan cycles accelerates funding for women, it is associated with slower funding for men.

female-promotional-language-slower.body: Female borrowers who use promotional language, such as describing themselves as 'deserving,' may fund more slowly.

male-technical-financial-terms-faster.body: Male borrowers who use technical financial terms like 'fixed operating capital' or 'cash flow' may fund faster.

female-family-support-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention spouse's employment or family support may fund faster.

female-specific-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific challenges like weather or input costs may fund faster.

female-food-security-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention increasing household food security may fund faster.

female-descriptive-inputs-slower.body: Female borrowers who use highly descriptive adjectives for farm inputs may fund more slowly.

female-inventory-list-slower.body: Female borrowers who list specific retail inventory items, such as canned goods and chips, may fund more slowly.

female-political-instability-faster.body: Detailed narratives regarding fleeing political instability may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-stability-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe institutional or physical stability, such as training or a permanent location, may fund faster.

female-gratitude-faster.body: Female borrowers who include an explicit expression of gratitude to lenders may fund faster.

female-hardworking-framing-faster.title: Female borrowers who frame the loan as an investment in a hardworking farmer may fund faster.
female-hardworking-framing-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for family support observation.

female-cost-increase-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention the rising cost of goods or commodities may fund more slowly.
female-cost-increase-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-initial-savings-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention starting their business with their own savings may fund faster.
female-initial-savings-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

male-crop-specialization-faster.title: Male borrowers who focus on a single crop rather than multiple crops may fund faster.
male-crop-specialization-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for new puzzles.

female-general-benefits-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention general biological benefits of inputs may fund more slowly.
female-general-benefits-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for food security observation.

female-family-composition-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about children or family composition may fund more slowly.
female-family-composition-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning number of children accelerated funding.

female-land-acquisition-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific dream of buying land to build a structure may fund faster.
female-land-acquisition-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-dual-purpose-faster.title: Female borrowers who combine business goals with educational goals fund faster than those mentioning education alone.
female-dual-purpose-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

male-quantified-assets-faster.title: Male borrowers who specify exact asset quantities, such as plot size or plant count, fund faster.
male-quantified-assets-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new stability observation.

female-aspirational-vs-operational.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language may fund faster than those who focus on quantitative operational details.
female-aspirational-vs-operational.retrospective: Retired as a stale puzzle to make room for new observations.
